# Bastián Felipe Lisperguer Aguayo

Canonical profile: https://www.vitairos.com/bastian-lisperguer/

Bastián Lisperguer is the founder and CEO of VITAIROS SpA, a teacher and a professional working in digital health, biomedical informatics, applied artificial intelligence and digital transformation in Chile.

## Main areas

- Digital health and biomedical informatics
- Applied artificial intelligence
- Health information systems and interoperability
- Custom software and process automation
- Technology education and responsible AI
- Digital inclusion and community technology support
